name: Ziluolan
source:
On Christmas Eve, the main character meets a girl in terrible circumstances, so he takes her home. Her purple hair looks so unusual that he is sure to have seen it before.
The story about pursuit of happiness begins.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节前夕，主角遇到了一个处境艰难的女孩，于是他带她回家。她的紫色头发看起来很不寻常，他肯定以前见过。
关于追求幸福的故事开始了。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
